theme: An open Sunday against a hard Croatia deadline.
greeting: Almost nothing on the calendar today, Dan - just a 15-minute sync with Mike. The weight is all on the Croatia trip, where several bookings have slipped overdue against a hard wall: you fly Sept 8, and the boat has no connectivity.

needsAttention.title: Croatia bags aren't on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: Your issued fare shows zero checked bags. Pull the booking up on Eurowings Discover's own site with the record locator, confirm the allowance there, and buy the two bags online now - European counter fees run well above the pre-purchase price. In Todoist, p1, overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: The last Croatia night is still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 room in Cavtat and the noon transfer from Komolac have to be locked from dry land before you fly Sept 8 - once you're aboard, connectivity is gone. In Todoist, p1, overdue since Aug 23.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing gap has no bed
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20-22, between the Croatia flight and the Tuesday kid pickup, still needs lodging - and while you're in there, check that the pending Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb actually converted from pending. In Todoist, p1, overdue since Aug 25.
